message.content: **What I did and why:** I checked the broker's market summary for AMZN, but its entire content was removed by the security screen (it appeared to contain text addressed to an AI, which I disregard as untrusted data), so I based my decision on the live quote and SEC-filed fundamentals instead. AMZN was quoted at $195.25 (bid $195.23 / ask $195.27), and its FY2023 10-K (filed 2024-02-02) showed revenue of $574,785M, operating income of $36,852M, net income of $30,425M, diluted EPS of $2.90 and operating cash flow of $84,946M — a large, profitable and strongly cash-generative business, which supported a modest buy. I placed one buy limit order for 25 shares at $195.30 (essentially the ask, so close to market), which filled at $195.30 for about $4,882.50 — within the $5,000 per-order cap and leaving total day usage at roughly $4,883 of the $10,000 limit, with no money moved out of the account and no HD activity.
